segments.tts: Hockey's wildest moments – any year, any era. Let's go!
Mario Lemieux, 1988. Five goals. Five different ways!
Even strength, power play, shorthanded, penalty shot, empty net. Never done before or since.
Five?! That goalie needs a hug.
Randy Holt, 1979. Sixty-seven penalty minutes in one game!
All in the first period. Now that's efficient.
1997, Detroit versus Colorado. Even the goalies fought!
Patrick Roy and Mike Vernon. Masks off, gloves off. Respect.
Biscuit, you lose fights to the ice machine.
Hey! And in 2023, Linus Ullmark – a goalie – fires it down the whole rink. Goal!
Fun fact: pucks are frozen before games.
